## Design

### 2026-10-05 — Currently finished my  sketches and idea on paper and worked on the PCB for a bit. Currently this project uses 2 50w 8Ohmes speakers with ESP32-S3, ES8388, 3.5 screen, 4 encoders, and a TPA3116D2 amp

**8h**

Currently finished my  sketches and idea on paper and worked on the PCB for a bit. Currently this project uses 2 50w 8Ohmes speakers with ESP32-S3, ES8388, 3.5 screen, 4 encoders, and a TPA3116D2 amp board to amplify the audio input. Currently it has a 1/4" input jack (mono) which runs through the Es8388 which relays to the ESP32  which with the 4 rotary encoders and maybe one 1 button to choose screen which will be able to add effects and eq.

### 2026-10-06 — Created a full schematic without the speakers but plan to create the project on a breadboard instead of a pcb. To create this on pcb there is too much wires so I plan to use one big breadboard to conn

**4h**

Created a full schematic without the speakers but plan to create the project on a breadboard instead of a pcb. To create this on pcb there is too much wires so I plan to use one big breadboard to connect everything at the top of the cabinet. As well as using Pcb is official so you cant change the desig n while on breadboard it is much cheaper to operate.

![image_2026-10-06_221032343](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/8cLsZFbpGEdZ6myvTQCEyxR6DBkYQdA3/22088e0bffc5aa94a1cbf73ae4042365fec2447135901dcca50b908980510733.png)

Issues with my pcb most of the imported parts did not have the right dimensions so I plan to create it on breadboard
